init.description: Genesis: Chain am HEAD verankern (einmalig). Option --seed-last N: letzte N Commits als Chain-Vorgeschichte
init.flow: init_flow(seed_last) -> chain_store.init_genesis() -> optional seed_history() -> stage narrative files -> session_store.reset()

prepare.description: idle -> prepared (nach git add; schreibt .doki/prompt.txt). Requires: AGENT_NAME, AGENT_ACTIVITY_SEED env vars, staged files
prepare.flow: prepare_flow.run(impulse, model_id) -> ensure idle -> check repo -> staged files non-empty -> claim ownership -> resolve impact scope -> write scope.json + agent_binding.json -> derive composite (RNG) -> build session -> build prompt -> save session -> write prompt.txt

finish.description: prepared -> verified. Body via --body, --body-file, or --stdin. Runs 10 checks (1-6 soft, 7-10 hard). Writes .commit_msg.txt + early artifacts (change_index.json, CHANGELOG.md) + stages them
finish.flow: finish_flow.run(body) -> ensure prepared -> analyze diff -> assemble message -> validate (10 checks) -> if hard errors: return errors -> write artifacts -> save session as verified -> return message

amend.description: DOKI-Message des letzten Commits nachbearbeiten (Body ersetzen). Checks 1-8 (chain-verankert), Check 9 (RNG-Replay) übersprungen

verify-only.description: Checks 1-10 auf Message (commit-msg Hook). Keine Nebenwirkungen
verify-only.flow: verify_only(message) -> if session not verified: try amend mode -> verifier.validate() or validate_amend()

gate.description: pre-commit Gate (Session + Snapshot + .commit_msg.txt). Ausnahmen: rebase, amend bestehender DOKI-Commits
gate.flow: gate_flow.run() -> check rebase -> check session state (must be verified) -> check .commit_msg.txt exists -> ownership gate -> snapshot gate -> scope gate -> byte/path drift gate -> path gate

finalize.description: verified -> idle (idempotent). Chain-Append, Arc-Advance, finalize artifacts (narrative_chain.json, arcs.json, change_index.json), stage them, cleanup transients
finalize.flow: finalize_flow.run() -> ensure verified (or idempotent) -> check HEAD changed -> idempotency guard (chain already has entry) -> chain_store.append_entry() -> index_store.link_commit() -> arc_engine.advance() -> artifact_writer.apply_finalize_artifacts() -> stage narrative files -> cleanup_transients() -> session_store.reset()

repair.description: Recovery: Crash / rebase / amend. 1) orphaned verified reset, 2) prepared reset, 3) chain anchor rebase
repair.flow: finalize_flow.repair() -> if verified orphan: record recovery, reset session -> if prepared: reset -> if chain anchor != HEAD: re-anchor

status.flow: status_flow.run() -> read chain + session -> return state

transitions.verified -> idle (repair): orphaned verified: HEAD unchanged, no commit -> atomic reset

state_machine.enforcement: SessionStore.ensure_state() validates expected state before each flow

error_handling.error_format: JSON with {"ok": false, "error": "..."} if --json, else printed with ✗ prefix

scope_determination.content_addressed: scope_path_digest, scope_constraint_digest, staged_byte_digest stored in session
scope_determination.gate_verification: Gate recomputes digests and compares to session values (fail-closed on drift)

format.genesis_date: set once at init (YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00), then fixed
format.anchor: {hash, subject, date} = Git HEAD at init
format.entries: [{seq, hash, composite, mood, narrator, model_id, summary, subject, prev_narrator, prev_model, date, arc, p_id, c, j, n, a, p, data_changes}]

chain_store_gd.integrity_checks: JSON parse normalizes all numbers to int (Godot 4.7 parses JSON numbers as float)
chain_store_gd.seed_history: init --seed-last N: derives deterministic composites from existing commits using subject+hash as diff_hash

single_active_owner.claim: fails if another agent holds active lock (fail-closed, no destructive cleanup)

session_store_gd.default_session: 60+ fields including composite, seed, tree_hash, diff_hash, impulse, narrator, mood, tone, structure, callback, model_id, prev_narrator, file_snapshot, impact, git_head_before, scope digests, p_id, c, j, n, a, p, arc_id, arc_name, is_arc_climax, sideplot, impulse_class, relationship, body_text, reason_lines

format.entities: {F-###: {id, type, name, path, status, first_p, last_p, history: [{p_id, action, lines}]}, C-###: ...}

change_index_store_gd.id_stability: Lookup by (path, type, name) -> existing ID across commits
change_index_store_gd.id_format: F-### for files, C-### for components (prefix includes dash)

key_operations: check git repo + staged files non-empty
derive composite via RNG (prev_composite + tree_hash + diff_hash + impulse)
decode j -> tone/structure/callback, select mood (!= prev_mood)
select narrator (n index), prev_narrator from chain
build sideplot context, change index analyze, arc forecast weight
prepare_flow_gd.determinism: All RNG via djb2 hash of inputs, no DateTime.now, no RandomNumberGenerator

key_operations: message_builder.assemble() -> full_message with subject, tokens, arc, reason_lines
if hard errors: return phase=verify with errors
artifact_writer.apply_commit_artifacts() -> writes .commit_msg.txt, change_index.json, CHANGELOG.md, stages them
parse next_arc from body (NÄCHSTER ARC: name — theme)
finish_flow_gd.verify_only: Separate path for commit-msg hook; handles amend mode if session idle + HEAD is DOKI commit

key_operations: skip if amend of existing DOKI commit (session idle + HEAD contains [COMPOSITE:)
ownership gate: session owner_token must match current agent
snapshot gate: staged files (minus auto-managed) must match session.file_snapshot
scope gate: re-resolve scope from FULL staged diff (including auto-managed), compare constraints to prepare-time
byte/path drift gate: recompute staged_byte_digest and path_digest, compare to session
path gate: staged files must exactly match snapshot
ensure session verified (or idempotent if already done)
idempotency guard: if chain last entry has same hash+composite -> just restage narrative files + reset session
artifact_writer.apply_finalize_artifacts() -> saves index, stages chain + arcs + index
repair: handles orphaned verified (HEAD unchanged), prepared reset, chain anchor rebase
finalize_flow_gd.amended_entry_hash_sync: Static function to update chain entry hash after git commit --amend (same composite, new hash)

status_flow_gd.key_operations: Read chain + session, return state, initialized, anchor, entries count, last entry, composite, narrator, mood, p_id, impulse, latest_c

commit_orchestrator_gd.initialization: Creates all stores (chain, session, index), engines (catalog, moods, git, sideplot, arc, relationship, voice, change_index_engine, verifier), builders (session, message, artifacts), flows (prepare, finish, finalize, gate, status)
commit_orchestrator_gd.delegation: prepare -> prepare_flow, finish -> finish_flow, finalize -> finalize_flow, gate -> gate_flow, status -> status_flow, amend -> local reconstruct + verifier.validate_amend

session_builder_gd.role: Builds session dict from prepare results + builds narrative context for voice_composer
session_builder_gd.build_session: Combines derive_result, impulse, model_id, prev_composite/mood/narrator/model/class, staged files, head_hash, sideplot, relationship, arc, arc_forecast, mood_pool, plot_id
session_builder_gd.build_narrative_context: Extracts files from analyze entities, gets effective attitudes from catalog + mood modifiers

git_helper_gd.role: All git operations, strict exit code handling
operations: search_context() -> runs global_search.gd + concept_index.gd (only if impulse requests search)

artifact_writer_gd.role: Writes narrative artifacts AFTER verification passes
artifact_writer_gd.apply_commit_artifacts: finish phase: save change_index.json, write CHANGELOG entry, write .commit_msg.txt, stage CHANGELOG + change_index (early artifact writing)
artifact_writer_gd.apply_finalize_artifacts: finalize phase: save change_index.json (with commit hash now known)
artifact_writer_gd.write_prompt_file: writes .doki/prompt.txt with SYSTEM/USER prompts + task instruction

change_index_engine_gd.role: Extracts entities from staged diff (F-### files, C-### components)
change_index_engine_gd.analyze: Parses git diff --cached hunks, extracts symbols (func/class/const/signal) with line numbers, ensures entities in index, builds data_changes (insertions/deletions per file)
change_index_engine_gd.diff_parsing: Handles diff --git headers, +++ path (strips a/b/ prefix), @@ hunk headers, tracks insertions/deletions

voice_composer_gd.system_prompt: Character (name, role, voice, tone_brief, style_sample), mood expression (lived not named), category calibration, attitudes (7 dimensions), prev_narrator context, relationship context, writing rules (story not report, mood via style, causal connectors, no bullets), side-plot merge rules
voice_composer_gd.user_prompt: ARC_CLIMAX handling, impulse, category, direction change, structure, technical text, side-plot commits, files list, sidejoke, trivial enforcement (deterministic exaggeration via djb2)
voice_composer_gd.build_subject: Narrator-specific subject templates with prev_narrator appended (— nach X)
voice_composer_gd.classify_impulse: Regex-based: DOKU, FIX, REFACTOR, BUILD, TEST-ASSET, TRIVIAL, CODE (default)

arc_engine_gd.non_narrative_classes: FIX, DOKU, TRIVIAL, TEST-ASSET -> weight 0, no climax
arc_engine_gd.forecast_weight: Called from prepare, computes weight from change_entities + is_merge + impulse_class
arc_engine_gd.advance: Called from finalize, updates arc weight/seen_entities, on climax: completes arc, creates next arc (a{N+1}), adopts narrator's next_arc suggestion

relationship_engine_gd.deterministic: Uses only chain timestamps (seq distance), no DateTime.now

sideplot_engine_gd.detection: Checks .git/MERGE_HEAD, runs git commands to find source/target branch, divergence point, side commits, narrators from chain

mood_overlay_gd.decoding: j % 10 -> tone, j % 7 -> structure, j > 50 -> callback
mood_overlay_gd.category_calibration: Adjusts mood expression per impulse_class (DOKU/FIX/TRIVIAL dampened)
mood_overlay_gd.mood_expression: How mood is LIVED in text (style/wording/rhythm), never named

data_files.arcs.json: 56+ arcs, active=a56, each with id, name, theme, status, weight, climax_weight, commit_count, seen_entities, span, version, completed_at
data_files.moods.json: Full mood definitions with expressions, category calibration, attitude modifiers, decoding rules, narrator_mood_combination examples
data_files.narrators.json: 14 characters with index, name, role, voice_traits, tone_brief, style_sample, attitudes (7 dims), verifier_rules (min/max words, regex), relationships
data_files.prompt_templates.json: Templates for mood_rules, attitude_texts, structure_hints, trivial_pool, subject_templates
data_files.doki_config.json: rng_limits (j:99, n:14, a:52, p:52), mood_pool_size:10, verifier.mood_uniqueness_check: true

6_State_Cache.scope_determination: staged files -> IMPACT_RESOLVER.resolve() -> scope.json (constraints/contracts) + session digests (path, constraint, byte)
6_State_Cache.agent_activity_integration: AGENT_NAME + AGENT_ACTIVITY_SEED from agent_activity.sh check-in -> owner_token -> session.claim() -> gate.assert_owner()
6_State_Cache.invalidation: session_store.reset() clears session + releases ownership; finalize_flow.cleanup_transients() removes prompt/body/commit_msg

agent_activity_sh.check_in: Records agent, task, files (--scope-from-staged uses git diff --cached), generates seed (agent:name:hostname:pid:time or agent:name:doki:DOKI_AGENT_SEED), writes registry + files list
agent_activity_sh.check_out: Requires --force if staged files exist, sets beat=0, status=NO-OUT
agent_activity_sh.gate: Validates seed matches, checks staged files covered by check-in (or auto-managed), checks branch rewind, checks active other locks
agent_activity_sh.recheck_in: For stale/NO-OUT agents: audit files with reasons, re-activate
agent_activity_sh.scope_feeding: --scope-from-staged feeds staged files to DOKI prepare via AGENT_ACTIVITY_SEED env var

preflight_gate.integration: DOKI gate_flow runs before commit, preflight.gd runs as separate CI step (compile_gate + test_all + preflight -x)
preflight_gate.cheap_path: Python-only staged files -> severity=python (no scene boot)

mcp_evidence.doki_story_test: 5-commit E2E test with real git commits (in test worktree)

checks: _test_rng_determinism: same input -> same composite/seed/mood; different impulse/diff -> different composite; c increments; fields in range
_test_xorshift: same seed -> same sequence; values in range; different seed -> different sequence
_test_decode_j: genesis tone, tone j%10, callback j>50
_test_verifier_positive: derive-based fixtures (chain entry 1 -> session entry 2), all checks pass
_test_verifier_hard_blocks: CHECK 7 (impulse missing, stale composite), CHECK 8 (unstaged doc diff), CHECK 9 (chain gap, RNG manipulation)
_test_verifier_file_limit: under/at/over MAX_FILES_PER_COMMIT; auto-managed narrative files excluded
_test_checks_soft: weak message (bullets, no causal connectors) -> soft errors only, success=true
_test_amend_reconstruction: normal replace, [MODEL: in body text doesn't break, non-DOKI head blocked, reconstructed passes validate_amend
_test_amend_hash_sync: same composite new hash -> sync; same hash -> idempotent; different composite -> no sync; no composite -> no sync; empty chain -> ok
_test_repair_orphaned_verified: decision logic (HEAD==anchor -> orphaned), atomic reset + recovery log, after reset flow works
_test_prompt_voice_lived: all moods have expression, all chars have style_sample, all categories have calibration, prompt contains them, DOKU calibration dampens euphoria
_test_new_recur_weight_swap: NEW_ENTITY_WEIGHT (0.4) > RECUR_ENTITY_WEIGHT (0.2); FIX not eligible; REFACTOR eligible with half base

doki_story_test_gd.description: 5-commit E2E story test with real git commits in test worktree
doki_story_test_gd.verifications: c-sequence gapless, p-sequence monotonic, narrator variance >=2, mood non-repeat adjacent, predecessor mentioned (causality), RNG replay per entry, CHANGELOG 1:1 sync, reason_lines per file, finalize retry idempotent

duplicate_state_locations.finding: narrative_chain.json, change_index.json, CHANGELOG.md, arcs.json exist at repo root (committed) AND are managed by DOKI flows. .doki/ directory holds transient state (session, owner, scope, prompt, etc.)
duplicate_state_locations.note: This is by design: narrative artifacts are committed, session state is transient. However, arcs.json lives in scripts/doki/data/ not .doki/ which is inconsistent

missing_doki_directory.finding: .doki/ directory is created on-demand by prepare_flow._write_scope_file() and artifact_writer.write_prompt_file() via DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute()
missing_doki_directory.note: No explicit .doki creation at init; first prepare creates it. Could be an issue if init runs without prepare

stale_session_handling.finding: repair() handles orphaned verified (HEAD unchanged) by atomic reset + recovery log. Prepared sessions reset on repair. Chain anchor re-anchored on rebase/amend
stale_session_handling.note: Verified orphan decision: HEAD == git_head_before -> orphaned (commit never happened or lost). Chain/Index files NOT touched (by contract)

scope_determination_bypasses.finding: Gate re-resolves scope from FULL staged diff (including auto-managed narrative files) and compares to prepare-time constraints. Byte/path digests computed from full diff. Any drift blocks commit
scope_determination_bypasses.note: Fail-closed: unknown/empty impact blocks prepare. Drift after prepare blocks gate. No auto-normalization

git_hook_integration_gaps.finding: No .githooks/ directory found in workspace. AGENTS.md mentions hooks but they're not present in the repo
details: pre-commit should run: agent_activity.sh gate (or doki gate)
git_hook_integration_gaps.agent_activity_sh_integration: agent_activity.sh has gate|run-preflight command but no hook installer

determinism_violations.finding: System is designed for full determinism. RNG uses djb2 + XorShift128 (no RandomNumberGenerator). Timestamps: genesis_date fixed at init, entry timestamps = genesis_date day + posmod(seq, 24). Mood selection guarantees != prev_mood. Arc advance uses deterministic weights
potential_issues: Time.get_datetime_string_from_system() used in FinalizeFlow.record_recovery() and metrics_updater.gd (non-deterministic but only for logging)
OS.get_ticks_msec() used in SessionStore.claim() for owner claimed_at (non-deterministic but only for lock timestamp)

file_locking_concurrent_access.finding: Single-Active-Owner pattern in SessionStore (owner.json with token) prevents concurrent prepare from different agents. However:
issues: No file locking on narrative_chain.json / change_index.json / arcs.json during concurrent finalize (unlikely as gate ensures single agent)
agent_activity.sh state in .git/agent-activity/ (per worktree) - no cross-worktree coordination
DOKI CLI runs via Godot headless - no process-level locking beyond owner_token

other_anomalies.finding: MAX_FILES_PER_COMMIT = -1 (unlimited) in verifier.gd but check_10 still exists and filters auto-managed files. The limit is effectively disabled but code path remains
SessionStore.default_session() has 80+ fields - large state object. Some fields like 'baseline_identity', 'scope_path_digest' duplicated from prepare_flow
arcs.json stores 56+ arcs with thousands of entity IDs in seen_arrays. ENTITY_WINDOW=50 limits active arc but completed arcs keep full history
SidePlotEngine uses OS.execute for git commands (direct shell) while GitHelper uses OS.execute with array args. Inconsistent git execution
prompt_templates.json exists but voice_composer.gd hardcodes most templates (subject_templates, trivial_pool, structure_hints). Data-driven approach partially implemented

DOKI_RngEngine.derive() asserts tree_hash and diff_hash non-empty but prepare_flow computes diff_hash = djb2(diff_output) which could be empty string if diff_cached returns empty (though staged files check prevents this)
